card.name: Diminutive endings inside names and nouns
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a word that is a diminutive or a foreign-style ending, such as -inho, -inha, -ino, -let, -ies, or the -to of Caporetto. It appears in general web text, often in Portuguese or Italian names and in words like froglet.
